description: This file is a shell script for testing git merge behaviors, specifically merge-recursive merging with renames and conflicts. It sets up a git repository with multiple branches, renames files, modifies contents, and performs merges to test the handling of renames and changes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution with a given description.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path is missing or does not exist.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
